normalization.force_balance: Euclidean norm(restrained-DOF reaction + applied catalogue resultant) / max(Euclidean norm(applied catalogue resultant),1e-12N)
normalization.moment_balance: Euclidean norm(restrained-DOF reaction moment + applied catalogue moment about origin) / max(force_scale*case_characteristic_length_mm,1e-12Nmm)
normalization.response_reference_scale: max(abs(case primary reference at requested load_factor),1e-12mm); never divide by a zero Cartesian component
normalization.reference_error: abs(measured primary response - declared signed/absolute reference)/response_reference_scale on finest mesh
normalization.gate_levels: Reference and cylinder pointwise displacement/stress on finest requested grid; signed force and moment balance, native completeness and geometry checks on every grid; retain all grid observations/errors and use finest/penultimate for mesh agreement.
normalization.cylinder_displacement_field: max absolute Cartesian component error across every node / response_reference_scale
normalization.cylinder_stress_field: max absolute Cartesian component error across every Gauss point / max(abs(analytic hoop stress at inner surface),1e-12MPa)
normalization.cross_solver_response: absolute primary response difference on identical case/settings/catalogue divided by response_reference_scale
normalization.cross_solver_displacement_field: max absolute Cartesian component difference across catalogue-matched nodes divided by response_reference_scale
normalization.cross_solver_stress_field: max absolute Cartesian component difference across identical elements and bijectively matched physical Gauss positions divided by max(max absolute component of both actual fields,1e-12MPa)
normalization.cross_solver_point_matching: same external element catalogue ID; unique physical-coordinate bijection with L-infinity tolerance1e-10*case_characteristic_length_mm; refuse missing/extra/duplicate/ambiguous match. Native POINT numbers are not interchangeable.
normalization.applied_load_reference: Independently compare force and moment to analytic continuous case integrals, normalized by analytic force norm and force norm*characteristic length, with mesh_volume_relative1e-3 bound. Native equilibrium still uses actual immutable catalogue loads and original1e-7 limits.
normalization.zero_and_invalid_policy: Explicit global positive scales/floors above handle zero reference components. Reject nonfinite/unrepresentable references or missing observations; retain failed measured metrics unchanged. No assembled residual or energy check is inferred.
